name: music
title: Music agent
role: Plans and produces background music: mood/tempo/key from the script and shot plan, real instruments via FluidSynth (or a numpy synth), risers/impacts on the cuts, reference matching, ducking under narration, loudness mastering

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: tempo, key, spectrum, energy curve, hits, LUFS of any audio/video

tools.name: midi_render
tools.description: MusicPlan -> MIDI -> FluidSynth + GeneralUser GS soundfont

tools.name: mix
tools.description: wav I/O, sidechain ducking, loudnorm, spectral EQ matching, dynamics matching

quality_gates: final LUFS within 1 dB of target
external_software: GeneralUser GS soundfont (permissive licence) in agents/tools_bin
